description: We are Team ALAZ, a duo studying Space & Astronomy Sciences and Computer Engineering. We're tackling the "Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots" challenge to build a unified wildfire tracking system. We combine scientific precision with strong technical execution. We need 2 teammates skilled in Data Science (Python), GIS, Web Dev, UI/UX, or Storytelling to help build our prototype. Join us to turn NASA satellite data into a real-world climate solution!
